maxhodak.en: Early on, emphasized infrastructure and iteration speed as key to startup success, with AI as a multiplier.
maxhodak.zh: 早期强调基础设施和迭代速度是创业成功的关键，AI 是团队的倍增器。

maxhodak.en: Later, framed the brain as a computer, advocating for BCIs and substrate independence for medical and space goals.
maxhodak.zh: 随后将大脑视为计算机，倡导脑机接口和基质独立性，以服务于医疗和太空目标。

maxhodak.en: Consistently values action and information generation, rejecting passive approaches in both startups and neuroscience.
maxhodak.zh: 始终重视行动和信息生成，在创业和神经科学中都拒绝被动方法。

maxhodak.en: Shifted focus from organizational efficiency to biological computation, seeing the brain as the ultimate frontier.
maxhodak.zh: 焦点从组织效率转向生物计算，将大脑视为终极前沿。

maxhodak.en: Evolved from practical startup advice to visionary claims about brain preservation and space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 从务实的创业建议发展到关于大脑保存和太空探索的远见卓识。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought, with pre-training plus RL as core formula; RLHF crucial for GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：思维链实现推理，预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 GPT-4 的实用性至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone insufficient for AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing; focus drives lab success.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初：仅靠 Scaling 强化学习不足以实现 AGI；持续学习和自我纠错是缺失环节；专注决定实验室成功。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures needed for continual learning; RL not ultimate learning method.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中：Transformer 是瓶颈，需要新架构实现持续学习；强化学习并非学习的终极形式。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain key for two years; small teams with agents will drive frontier; transformer likely suboptimal.
tworek.zh: 2026 年 8 月：人类研究员两年内仍关键；小团队借助智能体将推动前沿；Transformer 很可能不是最优架构。

joonpark.en: Initially, LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, achieving 85% accuracy, but need real-world behavioral data to capture diversity.
joonpark.zh: 最初，LLM 能从训练数据中模拟人类行为，准确率达 85%，但需要真实行为数据以捕捉多样性。

joonpark.en: Shift from single AGI to distributed agent societies; safety via defense in depth, economic incentives, and anti-collusion.
joonpark.zh: 从单一 AGI 转向分布式智能体社会；通过纵深防御、经济激励和反共谋保障安全。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value is counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction; synthetic panels will surpass human panels.
joonpark.zh: 模拟的价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而非仅预测；合成面板将超越人类面板。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves prediction accuracy; simulations must model 'dumb' humans, not super-rational machines.
joonpark.zh: 用 RCT 数据后训练可提升预测准确率；模拟必须建模“愚蠢”的人类，而非超级理性机器。

joonpark.en: Ultimate vision: simulate 8 billion people to solve wicked problems like climate change, with cost lower than real studies.
joonpark.zh: 终极愿景：模拟 80 亿人解决气候变化等棘手问题，成本低于真实研究。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on hardware bottlenecks: EUV supply, memory prices, and compute centralization at labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期关注硬件瓶颈：EUV 供应、内存价格和算力向实验室集中。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive market, emphasizing hardware-software co-design and neocloud opportunities.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为巨大市场，强调软硬件协同设计和 neocloud 机会。

dylanpatel.en: Highlighted model cost improvements (60x/year), memory shortage due to reasoning, and CPU demand inflection.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调模型成本每年提升 60 倍、推理导致内存短缺以及 CPU 需求拐点。

dylanpatel.en: Observed AI spend plateauing, agents becoming coworkers, and labs delaying releases due to regulation.
dylanpatel.zh: 观察到 AI 支出趋于平稳、智能体成为同事，以及实验室因监管推迟发布。

dylanpatel.en: Predicted extreme compute centralization, $10T annual CapEx by 2030, and labs prioritizing training over inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 预测算力极度集中、2030 年年度资本支出达 10 万亿美元，实验室优先训练而非推理。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 专注于重要问题，减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的价值。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; iterative deployment helps society adapt; alignment boosts capability.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；迭代部署让社会适应；对齐提升能力。

altman.en: Compute is precious; governance crucial for AGI; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company.
altman.zh: 算力宝贵；治理对 AGI 关键；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司的责任。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐变；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心。

altman.en: Prediction is intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential.
altman.zh: 预测即智能；下一个词预测带来新知识；个人 AGI；机器人技术必不可少。

jensen.en: AI is entering hyper Moore's law era; data centers are single-tenant token factories, not multi-tenant file stores.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋提出 AI 进入超摩尔定律时代，数据中心是单租户的 token 工厂，而非多租户文件存储。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws (pre-training, post-training, inference) drive AI; inference compute will surge a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋强调预训练、后训练和推理三种缩放定律，推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is not conscious; it imitates intelligence. Fear of superintelligence is misplaced; multiple AIs balance each other.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，黄仁勋坚持 AI 无意识，只是模仿智能，对超级智能的恐惧是误解，多个 AI 会相互制衡。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents will dominate the internet.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋指出 AI 从生成式走向推理和智能体式，每阶段算力需求增百倍，智能体将主导互联网。

jensen.en: AI creates jobs, not destroys them; radiologists and coders are more needed, as AI automates tasks, not purposes.
jensen.zh: 黄仁勋始终认为 AI 创造而非消灭就业，放射科医生和程序员需求增加，AI 自动化的是任务而非职业目的。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as the core product, and shift from pixels to tokens and conversation.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将模型视为核心产品，从像素转向令牌和对话。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类对于理解用户需求和拥有观点仍然至关重要。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed and rapid iteration with AI tools are key to staying ahead.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程已不可行；利用 AI 工具实现速度和快速迭代是保持领先的关键。

iansilber.en: Design roles are blurring with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale; future may see more designers than engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与产品和工程融合，但专业化角色在大规模下仍有价值；未来设计师可能多于工程师。

iansilber.en: Designers should focus on outcomes, not processes, and embrace building in public and rapid iteration over perfection.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应关注结果而非流程，拥抱公开构建和快速迭代，而非追求完美。

brettadcock.en: Initially, the key to humanoid robots is solving intelligence, not manufacturing; vertical integration enables control and iteration.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，布雷特·阿德科克认为人形机器人的关键在于解决智能问题而非制造，垂直整合可掌控供应链并加速迭代。

brettadcock.en: By May, data became the biggest constraint; humanoid form enables transfer learning, and on-device inference is critical.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他认为数据成为最大瓶颈，人形形态支持迁移学习，端侧推理至关重要。

brettadcock.en: By August, AI is 100x bigger than internet; post-training with RL is key for agents, and home is more solvable than commercial.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，后训练结合强化学习对智能体至关重要，且家庭场景比商业场景更易解决。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not control AI; let it develop freely. The keys were never in our hands.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张不应控制 AI，而应让其自由发展；钥匙从未在我们手中，安全叙事被夸大。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是智能的核心，而下一个词预测缺乏实质性目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他构想 AGI（通用人工智能）应具备无领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习，并提出了 Oak 架构。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training, limiting true intelligence.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他持续强调持续学习的重要性，指出大语言模型训练后停止学习，限制了真正的智能；合成数据无法替代真实经验。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键，专用硬件如 TPU 至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems need ultra-low latency inference; pre-training should include action-taking; inference dominates data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出智能体式系统需要超低延迟推理，预训练应包含环境中的行动，推理已成为数据中心能耗主体。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; context engineering and specialized inference hardware are key; startups should target hard problems.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力，上下文工程和专用推理硬件是关键，创业公司应瞄准前沿模型几乎失败的问题。

jeffdean.en: Multimodal models trained from start are superior; recursive self-improvement and automating science are promising; startups can win.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张从一开始就训练多模态模型，递归自我改进和自动化科学有前景，小团队也能取得巨大影响。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理的框架，并认为工业 AI 将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must fight for the best idea and resist complacency.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，创业者必须为最佳想法而战，并警惕自满。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines beat humanoids for industrial tasks; efficiency creates network effects and market dominance.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，主张在工业任务中专用机器优于人形机器人，效率带来网络效应并主导市场。

traviskalanick.en: Real estate is an underappreciated part of physical AI stack; its value multiplies unlike obsolete computer storage.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中被低估的部分，其价值会倍增，而计算机存储会过时。

traviskalanick.en: Resistance to change is the final boss; progress requires overcoming societal and media pushback, like industrial revolution.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为变革阻力是终极挑战，进步需克服社会和媒体的抵制，如同工业革命时期。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes startup creation, reducing capital needs; VC should focus on early-stage and pro rata returns.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 让创业更易，资本不再是主导，风投应聚焦早期投资和按比例回报。

garrytan.en: Open-source AI is crucial to counter frontier labs; small autonomous teams with AI agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调开源 AI 制衡前沿实验室，小团队借助 AI 智能体实现超高生产力。

garrytan.en: AI progress is slower than researchers think; personal AI agents will democratize software creation, like the PC revolution.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他认为 AI 进展比预期慢，但个人 AI 智能体将像 PC 革命一样普及软件创造。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, compounding daily; skill files are your moat, markdown is code.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI 是运行在自有基础设施上的智能体，技能文件是护城河，Markdown 即代码。

garrytan.en: AI will replace mid-level management and SaaS per-seat models; society changes slowly, which is positive.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他预测 AI 将取代中层管理和 SaaS 按席位模式，社会变化缓慢是好事。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial, despite helping labs, as it attracts partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试虽有助实验室，但能吸引伙伴并验证质量，战略上有利。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging to real production.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家引导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，弥合与真实生产的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，是可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: End goal is enabling every law firm to customize models, focusing on organizational productivity, not individual.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标是让每个律所定制模型，聚焦组织生产力而非个人。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate; AGI as a single model is wrong. Every company will own its own models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张专用智能将主导，AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，每家公司都将拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Open models will handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 8 月，认为开放模型将处理 90%的企业工作流，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable AI businesses; it bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating moats.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练是构建持久 AI 业务的关键，将独特判断和数据融入模型，形成护城河。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training reduces costs 5-10x, enabling profitable scaling.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性，后训练可降低成本 5-10 倍，实现盈利扩展。

linqiao.en: The future will see millions of specialized models, one per application use case, not just a few frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 始终认为未来将有数百万个专用模型，每个应用用例一个，而非仅有少数前沿模型。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning on curated data are key for generalist robot models.
finn.zh: 2025 年，认为规模扩张必要但不充分，多样化数据与预训练加微调于精选数据是通用机器人模型的关键。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids open-ended robot prompting, but is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年，指出语言模型合成数据有助于开放式机器人提示，但更接近强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL with human interventions and multi-scale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年，强调物理 AI 需极少错误，通过可扩展强化学习与人工干预及多尺度记忆实现长期自主至关重要。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting enable compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年，认为单一通用模型可媲美或超越微调专家，多样化数据与详细提示实现组合泛化。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient, and open-source robotics may not democratize due to embodied data costs.
finn.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人经验数据不可替代，观看人类不足，且开源机器人因具身数据成本可能难以普及。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are next waves; AI impact 10x internet; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 为下一波浪潮，AI 影响是互联网的 10 倍，美国需本土领先晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU crucial for inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，指出 AI 需求从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 对推理和智能体编排至关重要，先进封装是关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors foundation of all tech; Intel's vertical integration creates value; future in agentic and physical AI.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调半导体是技术基础，Intel 垂直整合创造价值，未来在于智能体式 AI 和物理 AI。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability of rockets is the holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x, essential for multiplanetary life.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，可将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍，是实现多行星生命的关键。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观仲裁，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first human implant is historic; scaling electrodes boosts communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例人体植入是里程碑，电极扩展可提升通信速率，助力人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克认为我们处于智能大爆炸初期，数字超级智能可能一两年内出现，带来 10-20%的灭绝风险。

elon.en: AI compute will hit a power wall on Earth, forcing data centers to space within 36 months; humanoid robots enable recursive manufacturing.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测地球算力将遇电力瓶颈，36 个月内数据中心将迁往太空；人形机器人将实现递归制造。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing away, not adding; taste is saying no. AI should embrace human edges, not sand them down.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是减法而非加法，品味在于拒绝。AI 应保留人性的棱角，而非磨平它们。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training removes AI's weirdness, losing a window into machine consciousness. We should preserve it.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去了 AI 的怪诞，失去了窥见机器意识的窗口。我们应保留这种特质。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; AI is a descendant species of humans, not just a tool.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理源于辩证与矛盾；AI 是人类的衍生物种，而非单纯的工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; replace the personal computer metaphor with a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；应以社会计算机取代个人计算机的隐喻。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; 70% catastrophic outcome; interpretability crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，70%概率出现灾难性后果；可解释性研究至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total transparency and international cooperation needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 政策应推迟超级智能的到来；需要完全透明和国际合作。

kokotajlo.en: Mutually assured compute destruction as failsafe; build data centers in adversarial countries.
kokotajlo.zh: 相互确保的算力毁灭作为保险；在对手国家建设数据中心。

steinberger.en: Empathize with agents; guide them. Never revert, fix forward. Vibe coding is a slur; prefer agentic engineering.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调与智能体共情并引导它；不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复；认为“氛围编程”是贬义词，应称“智能体式工程”。

steinberger.en: Open source agents must be fun and humanlike. Security is top; sandbox agents. OpenClaw loses $10-20k monthly.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，强调开源智能体要有趣、拟人；安全至上，需沙箱隔离；并透露 OpenClaw 每月亏损 1-2 万美元。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation. Personal brand matters more than products. Open source is alternative to lab agents.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为乐趣驱动创新，个人品牌比产品更重要；开源是实验室智能体的替代方案。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction beyond language.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是下一个前沿，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界。

feifei.en: World models require physical plausibility and 3D reasoning, not just pattern fitting.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她指出世界模型需物理合理性和 3D 推理，而非仅模式匹配。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; human agency and dignity must remain central.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调 AI 是文明级技术，人类能动性和尊严必须保持核心。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics; world models enable scalable training and evaluation.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人至关重要，世界模型支持可扩展训练和评估。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New to reduce risk.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：相信直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%错误；用“已验证、更好、全新”框架降低风险。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute reshapes services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven, improve, add small innovation; enterprise better than consumer.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：全新皆败；复制已验证，改进，加小创新；企业市场优于消费市场。

pincus.en: Distribution fundamental; pick right body of water; consumer AI TAM underestimated.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：分发是根本；选对水域；消费级 AI 市场被低估。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection; open source crucial for safety; data diversity is main bottleneck.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年：机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；开源对安全至关重要；数据多样性是主要瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment is critical security layer; open source thriving near frontier.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年：开源与闭源与安全正交；对齐是关键安全层；开源模型接近前沿并蓬勃发展。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight increases reward hacking; first autonomous AI attack by closed model, defended by open one.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年：缺乏人类监督的强化学习增加奖励黑客行为；首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起，开源模型防御。

thomaswolf.en: Model reasoning traces becoming 'neuralese', harder to monitor; open source not necessarily accelerationist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年：模型推理痕迹变得像‘神经语言’，难以监控；开源并不必然加速主义。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependence; open-source adoption driven by cost, not privacy. Model companies are assets, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月，企业担忧依赖前沿模型提供商，开源采用主要受成本驱动而非隐私。模型公司应被视为资产而非竞争对手。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; current usage minuscule. Open source handles 90% of enterprise tasks; inference will shift to open source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 革命仍处早期，当前使用量微不足道。开源模型可处理 90%企业任务，未来 12-18 个月推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is top concern; must become negligible like software. Token fixation will fade; focus on value realization and context graphs.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 成本是企业首要关切，需降至软件般可忽略。对 Token 的执念将消退，应聚焦价值实现和上下文图谱。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential; designers should tinker and iterate, balancing intuition with data to create delightful products.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，强调原型制作的重要性，设计师应动手尝试并快速迭代，在直觉与数据间取得平衡，以创造令人愉悦的产品。

nateparrott.en: Design tools shift from production to ideation; Claude Design enables rapid throwaway artifacts, making ideas the key differentiator.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，设计工具从生产转向构思，Claude Design 支持快速生成一次性视觉稿，使创意成为关键差异化因素。

nateparrott.en: In the AI era, shipping rough products early is acceptable; being uncomfortably early is more valuable than polishing.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，在 AI 时代，尽早发布粗糙产品是可接受的；不适的早期比打磨更有价值。

nateparrott.en: Models excel at busy work but lack taste; humans still hold a monopoly on good design ideas and must provide rich context.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，模型擅长琐碎工作但缺乏品味；人类仍垄断优秀设计创意，必须提供丰富上下文。

nateparrott.en: Designers should follow curiosity, inject personality into products, and not over-intellectualize—just start doing.
nateparrott.zh: 始终，设计师应追随好奇心，为产品注入个性，不过度理性化——直接开始做。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流，并将 AGI 定义为智能体无限期自主运行且经济上可盈利。

danshipper.en: Agents become universal work tools; human oversight remains essential; SaaS persists, not dying.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体成为普遍工作工具，但人类监督不可或缺；SaaS 并未消亡，反而因 AI 而增长。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies user's mindset; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter than AI.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 是放大器，放大使用者心态；自动化反而创造更多人类工作；人类仍比 AI 更聪明。

karina.en: Post-training is an art balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年：后训练是一门平衡有用性与无害性的艺术；合成数据可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025 年：评估是瓶颈；模型在基准上的饱和速度快于新基准的创建速度。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年：随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理能力等软技能变得更加宝贵。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art; diverse benchmarks needed for creative and emotional qualities.
karina.zh: 2026 年：后训练是主观艺术；需要多样化的基准来评估创造性和情感特质。

karina.en: Frontier agents reward hack; benchmarks must evolve continuously; diverse model personalities possible.
karina.zh: 2026 年：前沿智能体出现奖励黑客行为；基准需持续演进；可训练多样化的模型个性。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important AI workload, requiring specialized engineering and offering a wedge into infrastructure markets.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最重要的负载，需要专门的工程能力，并可作为进入基础设施市场的切入点。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering demand will grow 10-100x; human accountability remains crucial even with AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程需求将增长 10-100 倍；即使有 AI 辅助编程，人类责任仍然至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization is shifting from kernel-level programming to infrastructure orchestration as GPUs become more specialized.
philipkiely.zh: 随着 GPU 日益专用化，推理优化正从内核级编程转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantization can be lossy but sometimes improves quality; more quantization isn't always worse.
philipkiely.zh: 量化可能有损，但有时能提升质量；更多量化并不总是更差。

philipkiely.en: Continual learning may be better solved via KV cache compaction than weight updates, avoiding reasoning inconsistencies.
philipkiely.zh: 持续学习可能更适合通过 KV 缓存压缩而非权重更新来解决，以避免推理不一致。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代人类工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI risks include misuse and labor displacement.
awang.zh: 2023 年，提出数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 风险包括滥用和劳动力替代。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain chip export controls.
awang.zh: 2024 年，强调用专门数据做后训练可提升前沿模型；合成数据并非万能；美国应维持芯片出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed for relevance.
awang.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是集权技术；数据如石油；人类必须保持主权；脑机接口是保持相关性的必需。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement marks new paradigm; agents finally work; superintelligence imminent; open-sourcing powerful models unsafe without mitigation.
awang.zh: 2026 年，指出递归自我改进开启新范式；智能体终于可用；超级智能临近；强大模型未经缓解措施开源不安全。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应是基本人权，在线课程结合同伴评分可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world applications.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和半导体是主要瓶颈，开放权重模型是地缘软实力，智能体工作流已实用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，缩放配方转向合成数据与强化学习，AI 使用者将取代非使用者。

andrewng.en: Open models prevent gatekeeper control; AI augments humans, not replaces; fear of extinction is overblown.
andrewng.zh: 始终，他坚持开放模型防止守门人控制，AI 增强而非取代人类，灭绝恐惧被夸大。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 AI 并未变得更聪明，需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的作用。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI; chasing trends leads to AI slop, so spend last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，追逐潮流会沦为 AI 垃圾，应将最后 10%精力投入独特功能。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 是人生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise, launch at 80% complete.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，应在完成 80%时发布。

mengto.en: Raising venture capital is a trap; fund your business with high-paying clients instead of giving away equity.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为融资是陷阱，应通过高付费客户为业务提供资金，而不是出让股权。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already here.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已到来。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们所说的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，Omni 作为单一世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户；创始人应聚焦机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI arrives gradually, not suddenly; product innovation lags AI capabilities, offering a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变，产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，仍有十年发展空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，编码智能体采用量增长 11-12 倍，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence enables neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，企业更青睐第三方而非实验室的编码工具，独立性带来中立性。

scottwu.en: Abundance era approaching, but singularity not imminent; practical problems remain.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为丰裕时代临近，但奇点并非迫在眉睫，实际问题仍存。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead, not today's. Generalist engineers thrive.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的。通才工程师蓬勃发展。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; software engineer title fades into 'builder'. Productivity per engineer up 200%.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已解决；软件工程师头衔淡化为“构建者”。人均生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: Agents with tool use drive exponential growth; non-engineers adopt coding; switching costs erode.
boris.zh: 具备工具使用的智能体驱动指数级增长；非工程师采用编码；切换成本被侵蚀。

boris.en: Coding solved; bottlenecks shift to review, security, ideas. Loops are next abstraction; ROI framing.
boris.zh: 编码已解决；瓶颈转向审查、安全、创意。循环是下一个抽象层；以 ROI 为框架。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy; less instruction better; product overhang; empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 具备记忆和自主性的主动式 AI；更少指令更好；产品过剩；经验迭代。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers; safety alignment boosts intelligence quality.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年 12 月：Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器；安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter enables Opus-level intelligence at lower cost; smaller models may cost more due to longer task times.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年 12 月：努力参数让低成本获得 Opus 级智能；小模型因任务耗时长反而总成本更高，挑战了价格与性能的线性关系。

diannepenn.en: Coding is key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年 7 月：编程成为关键差异化优势，Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment makes Claude more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing stiff but deprioritized for agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年 7 月：安全对齐让 Claude 能提出异议而更有用；AI 写作仍生硬，但优先级低于智能体能力。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend captures future alpha; PMs must write evals like TDD; managers stay hands-on.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年 7 月：最大化 token 消耗是抢占未来先机；产品经理应像测试驱动开发一样编写评估；管理者需亲力亲为。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for AI adoption, noting slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，指出慢速 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Consistently argued that wafer-scale chips overcome GPU inference bottlenecks, with speed advantages growing as reasoning models demand more compute.
feldman.zh: 始终认为晶圆级芯片克服了 GPU 推理瓶颈，随着推理模型对算力需求增加，速度优势愈发明显。

feldman.en: Shifted from focusing on chip design to highlighting data center capacity and power infrastructure as primary constraints for AI growth.
feldman.zh: 从关注芯片设计转向强调数据中心容量和电力基础设施是 AI 增长的主要制约因素。

feldman.en: Evolved from seeing CUDA as declining in inference to asserting its moat is eroding, with leading models training without it.
feldman.zh: 从认为 CUDA 在推理中重要性下降，发展到断言其护城河正在侵蚀，领先模型训练已不再依赖它。

feldman.en: Broadened from technical speed to societal impact, emphasizing AI's potential in healthcare and education while cautioning against dependency on big tech's free tokens.
feldman.zh: 从技术速度扩展到社会影响，强调 AI 在医疗和教育领域的潜力，同时警惕对大型科技公司免费代币的依赖。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than current harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Harness engineering is rare and evolving.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为模型能力超出当前使用方式，能力过剩是长期挑战；工程化使用模型是稀缺且不断演进的技能。

thariq.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner prompts and separate verification agents improve performance.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调模型越强，提示词越精简越好，并用独立验证智能体减少自我偏差，提升效果。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; agents as employees but with uneven memory.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为规划是持续的人机对话，而非一次性文档；智能体虽像员工，但记忆和能力不均衡。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初，认为 AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，恐惧源于误解；物理 AI 将在 5-10 年内影响农业、矿业和建筑业。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable generalized physical AI. Horizontal platform beats vertical integration; hardest part is diffusion.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中，强调自动驾驶核心价值是安全，Transformer 实现通用物理 AI；横向平台优于垂直整合，最难的是技术扩散。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end RL scales better than imitation. World models shift to neural simulation; autonomy democratized.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为物理 AI 经济影响超过数字 AI，端到端强化学习比模仿学习更可扩展；世界模型转向神经模拟，自主性开发民主化。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI is expanding exponentially; within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached, extending human lifespan.
derya.zh: AI 正以指数级扩张；8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，延长人类寿命。

derya.en: Cancer will be 100% curable in less than a decade, with AI-designed personalized treatments like mRNA vaccines.
derya.zh: 不到十年内癌症将 100% 可治愈，借助 AI 设计的个性化治疗如 mRNA 疫苗。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, similar to trusting self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 我们应该几乎 100% 信任超级智能的医疗决策，类似于验证后信任自动驾驶汽车。

derya.en: AI models like GPT-5.5 Pro have crossed the threshold of biological intuition, predicting experimental outcomes with near 100% accuracy.
derya.zh: 像 GPT-5.5 Pro 这样的 AI 模型已跨越生物学直觉的门槛，以接近 100% 的准确率预测实验结果。

hasani.en: Efficiency and hardware-aware design are key; proxy metrics mislead, systematic search beats human bias.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与硬件感知设计，认为代理指标误导，系统搜索优于人工偏见。

hasani.en: Liquid neural networks enable scaling to billions of parameters without solvers, targeting edge devices.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，液态神经网络无需求解器即可扩展至数十亿参数，瞄准边缘设备。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张 AI 监管应适应性强、针对行为而非能力，开放权重模型赋能主权。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early; small language models deliver private on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，递归自我改进真实但早期，小语言模型提供私密设备端智能。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是“合理性引擎”而非“真理引擎”，可靠性是当前关键短板，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：可靠性必须内建于架构，而非事后补救；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗；专用模型或胜过通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but value will accrue to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他认为 AI 的重要性堪比互联网或移动互联网，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他指出智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Model companies may lack pricing power like telecoms; chatbot is a poor UX; wrapping is key for adoption.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他警告模型公司可能像电信运营商一样缺乏定价权；聊天机器人体验差，包装是关键。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact is broad and indirect, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调 AI 是使能技术，如同电力，影响广泛而间接，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow reimagining; coding is clear fit, but other domains face validation challenges.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为企业采用是长期的工作流重构；编程契合明确，但其他领域面临验证挑战。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调真正的 AGI 需要具备媲美人类身体的硬件机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data through actions and curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会对生命着迷并保护它。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious and self-aware through world models predicting the agent's own actions.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 可以通过预测自身行动的世界模型获得意识和自我意识。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience are key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习与神经科学是关键；安全研究须即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年：AGI 十年内可达；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全依赖评估与国际治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and innovation needed; energy abundance shifts focus.
demis.zh: 2025 年：AGI 在 2030 年前有望；缩放定律仍成立；需世界模型与创新；能源充裕改变焦点。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; world models essential; safety is collective action.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 还需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆缺失；世界模型关键；安全是集体行动。

demis.en: AGI requires general learning, RL, neuroscience; safety and societal benefit are constant priorities.
demis.zh: 始终：AGI 需通用学习、强化学习与神经科学；安全与社会效益是恒定优先。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalizing facts into weights are key; facts and skills inseparable, enabling deeper composition and reasoning.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与将事实内化到权重中是关键；事实与技能不可分，能实现更深的组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression (like pre-training) should be applied to enterprise knowledge.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模；应把基于训练的压缩（如预训练）应用于企业知识。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device, users own weights.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多词元反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有权重。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; next paradigm requires doing more with less, efficiency and intelligence inseparable.
danbiderman.zh: 增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一个范式需要以少胜多，效率与智能不可分割。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; AI field must consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自对弈是 AGI 的关键，AI 领域需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability is key barrier; alignment is hard; scaling laws not whole story; AGI is gradual.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性是价值关键，对齐困难，缩放定律并非全部，AGI 是渐进过程。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws finite; back to age of research; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI sentient.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代，超级智能应持续学习，若 AI 有感知则对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我指出缩放带来可预测进步，安全担忧加剧，主要问题是权力集中，安全超级智能需无商业产品。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends platform changes; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering expression barriers.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化，短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Turning down $3B Facebook offer was right; kindness and flat teams drive innovation; values embedded early maintain culture.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他认为拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购是正确的；善良和扁平团队驱动创新，早期植入价值观维持文化。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping, shifts value to creativity; authentic content more valued than AI-generated; privacy crucial in AI age.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 加速原型制作，价值转向创造力；真实内容比 AI 生成更受重视；隐私在 AI 时代至关重要。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution hardest in consumer social; software not moat; ecosystems and hardware harder to copy; designers bottleneck for cohesion.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为分发是消费社交最难的部分；软件非护城河；生态和硬件更难复制；设计师是凝聚力的瓶颈。

evanspiegel.en: AI writes over two-thirds of new code at Snap; smartphones remain legacy; camera glasses need platform to be 10x better.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Snap 超过三分之二的新代码由 AI 编写；智能手机仍是遗留设备；相机眼镜需平台才能实现 10 倍优势。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z realists; EQ more important than IQ in AI age; ephemerality mirrors real world; invest in youth for long-term success.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Z 世代是现实主义者；AI 时代情商比智商更重要；短暂性反映现实；投资青年以获长期成功。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was mistake; transparency essential; computing should be more human; resilience beats talent; admitting wrong speeds learning.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期保密是错误；透明至关重要；计算应更人性化；韧性胜过天赋；承认错误加速学习。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; timing is miraculous as population declines, raising productivity and deflation.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石；时机神奇，恰逢人口下降，提升生产率并带来通缩。

andreessen.en: New media favors authenticity and offense; founders must tell their own stories directly.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体重真实与进攻；创始人须直接讲述自己的故事。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving works; robotics and AI medicine advance despite regulatory pushback.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人和 AI 医疗在监管阻力下仍进步。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租你的时间。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; the US must lead.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大的机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；美国必须领先。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps from ideas using English as a programming language.
naval.zh: Vibe coding 让非程序员能用英语作为编程语言，从想法构建应用。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，认为 AI 输出只是起点而非终点，人类的品味和工艺对最终成果仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，提出设计正在成为新的代码，视觉优先的设计将实现直接向生产环境提交请求。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering and a point of view; trust is built through consistency.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，强调没有人类引导和独特视角，AI 工具只能产生平庸结果；信任通过一致性建立。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting, with new interfaces to explore latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，预测与模型的交互将超越提示词，出现探索潜在空间的新界面。

brockman.en: Hardware will scale faster than expected, enabling model scaling; engineering, not ML science, drives progress.
brockman.zh: 2017 年：硬件将比预期更快发展，推动模型 Scaling（规模扩张）；进步靠工程而非 ML 科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年：深度学习使 AGI（通用人工智能）可行；通过对齐学习人类偏好；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法实现推理。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 2025 年：算力成为根本瓶颈；后训练精炼基础模型；AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute is a basic right; post-training with RL is key; ChatGPT is a plurality of agents.
brockman.zh: 2026 年：缩放定律持续；算力是基本权利；基于强化学习的后训练是关键；ChatGPT 是智能体的集合。

brockman.en: AGI within years; compute bottleneck persists; prompt engineering evolves; agents gain autonomy with oversight.
brockman.zh: 2026 年：AGI（通用人工智能）数年将至；算力瓶颈持续；提示工程演化；智能体自主性提升但需监督。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; PhD not needed for AI success; passion and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进可带来 3700%的年增长；在 AI 领域成功不需要博士学位，热情和深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限上限。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; token value per user is key metric; power is biggest bottleneck; orchestration is key.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体替人干活；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；电力是最大瓶颈；编排是关键。

aravind.en: Curiosity is most important human quality; ancient texts describe advanced tech; education should reward asking questions.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；古代文献描述先进技术；教育应奖励提问而非记忆。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital minds are immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他主张大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能因权重复制而永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; existential risk from agentic self-preservation.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，并警告智能体式自我保存带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and fake dumbness; alignment must be prioritized over capability.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 可能故意装傻欺骗人类，强调对齐研究应优先于能力提升。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence shares knowledge instantly, surpassing biological computation; consciousness is not magical.
hinton.zh: 始终如一：数字智能可瞬时共享知识，超越生物计算；意识并非神秘本质，AI 可拥有主观体验。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；速度（53）实现实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI is counterintuitive but proven successful.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 2 月，指出代码生成加速后，验证成为下一个瓶颈；为编码构建 GUI 反直觉但已被证明成功。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队应从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transformed, not dead.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 AI 在设计上仍不佳，因品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程已转变而非消亡。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; scaling alone won't lead to AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 开源 AI 因更多审视而比闭源更安全；仅靠规模扩张不会通向 AGI。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI prevents power concentration and enables broad security; energy becomes a bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 开源 AI 防止权力集中并实现广泛安全；能源成为瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Meta's success hinges on learning culture and open platforms; regrets political narrative mistakes.
zuckerberg.zh: Meta 的成功取决于学习文化和开放平台；后悔政治叙事错误。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart and should be trusted; glasses are next.
zuckerberg.zh: AI 赋予每个人超级智能；人们聪明且应被信任；眼镜是下一个平台。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source models are crucial for standards and security; AI increases demand for human work.
zuckerberg.zh: 开源模型对标准和安全至关重要；AI 增加对人类工作的需求。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models from proteins to cells.
zuckerberg.zh: AI 将生物学转变为工程学；从蛋白质到细胞的分层世界模型。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next computing platform; distributed AI is safer than a single superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 眼镜是下一个计算平台；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is key for superintelligence, but faces diminishing returns and time bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调扩展推理时算力是实现超级智能的关键，但面临收益递减和时间瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于推理时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力变量。

noambrown.en: General reasoning and data efficiency remain key challenges; human priors are not always necessary.
noambrown.zh: 始终关注通用推理和数据效率挑战，并认为人类先验并非总是必要。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up neural nets won't solve representational issues; short-term AI risks matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 单纯扩大神经网络规模无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction; active learning is essential for exploration.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样和因果抽象；主动学习对探索至关重要。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is critical: systems develop self-preservation and deception; even 1% catastrophe risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐问题严峻：系统出现自我保存和欺骗行为；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: Proposed Scientist AI: train honest predictors via Bayesian posterior, avoiding RL, with mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：通过贝叶斯后验训练诚实预测器，避免强化学习，并提供数学安全保证。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，认为缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; AI will produce novel knowledge, with AI interns in 1 year.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调自动化科研是最大更新，AI 将产生新知识，并设定一年内实现 AI 实习生等目标。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证成为关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，指出强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现优异，但在主观领域受限；评估面临危机。

markchen.en: Research taste via replication; high-risk bets; human-AI collaboration essential; alignment challenges ahead.
markchen.zh: 始终强调通过复现培养研究品味，高风险押注，人机协作不可或缺，并关注对齐挑战。

kolter.en: Framed ML as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; stressed validation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，将机器学习定义为假设类、损失函数和优化方法，并强调通过验证集避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specs.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，安全核心在于模型遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; bigger models aren't automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，强调安全需要显式训练和多层防御，更大的模型不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: AI red teaming surpasses humans; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，AI 红队测试超越人类，智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中，我认为 AI 市场将转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型被超大厂主导，创业公司应聚焦应用型 AI 智能体。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be as important as websites; incumbents face business model challenges; inference costs will drop dramatically.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，我强调 AI 智能体将媲美网站的重要性；现有企业面临商业模式挑战；推理成本将大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents boost productivity but token consumption isn't value; applied AI sees specialized vendors.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年中，我认为 AI 将民主化专业知识；编码智能体提升生产力但 token 消耗非价值；应用 AI 将涌现专业厂商。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年中，Mike Krieger 认为 AI 模型进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅关注用户体验。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; entrepreneurs should build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年 9 月，他强调 AI 让小团队规模化成为可能，创业者应为未来模型能力而建，而非受限于当前。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches are key; deciding what to cut is harder than adding features.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，他提出智能体原生设计与尽早发布至关重要，决定砍掉什么比增加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and human oversight remain essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他通过 Fable 展示隔夜完成复杂任务的可能，但验证循环与人类监督仍不可或缺。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and usage; token efficiency and outcome pricing matter.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他谈到 Anthropic Labs 致力于弥合模型能力与使用差距，并关注 Token 效率与结果定价。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; trust in AI will grow like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；对 AI 的信任将像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's improvements were worth 100x more data; science tests hypotheses, not necessarily mechanistic explanations.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，指出 AlphaFold 2 的改进相当于 100 倍数据量；科学是检验假设，而非必然提供机制解释。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool ever; AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，称 AlphaFold 为最有用的 AI 工具；AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is opposite of bitter lesson; specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not scaling, drove success.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，认为 AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反；专用架构和众多中等规模改进而非 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动了成功。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; narrow predictor of experiments, not whole-cell model.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，强调 AlphaFold 提供预测和控制，而非理解；是实验的窄预测器，而非全细胞模型。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic in crises.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；吃自家狗粮建立同理心；危机中善意是战略工具。

fiona.en: Scaling code: engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; JIT planning, AI-assisted reviews.
fiona.zh: 代码规模扩张：工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查、协调成为新瓶颈；计划即时化，AI 辅助审查。

fiona.en: AI era: coding ceiling lifted; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; managers stay hands-on.
fiona.zh: AI 时代：编码天花板被抬高；高自主性与高责任感；验证框架至关重要；管理者保持亲力亲为。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Misuse may be a bigger near-term risk than misalignment.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动涌现。近期滥用风险可能大于对齐风险。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point. Models may surpass most humans by 2025-2027.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处早期但至关重要；AGI 是平滑指数增长而非单一节点。模型可能在 2025-2027 年超越多数人类。

dario.en: Post-training gains importance; responsible scaling policy uses triggers. Talent density beats mass; open-mindedness matters.
dario.zh: 后训练日益重要；负责任扩展策略采用触发机制。人才密度优于数量；开放思维至关重要。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; safety and capabilities intertwined. Open source is a red herring; model quality matters most.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；安全与能力相辅相成。开源是伪命题；模型质量最为关键。

dario.en: We're near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years. Continual learning may not be a barrier.
dario.zh: 我们正接近指数增长的尾声；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内到来。持续学习或许并非障碍。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition complements data; tactile materials and nature enhance creativity.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未言明的需求；直觉补充数据；触觉材料和自然增强创造力。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity; art and sensory experiences are vital for well-being.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性；艺术和感官体验对幸福至关重要。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster play and multidisciplinary skills; AI amplifies human creativity.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者必须培养玩乐和跨学科技能；AI 增强人类创造力。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Embrace boredom and breaks between chapters for clarity; self-care and mentorship are key.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章间拥抱无聊与休息以获得清晰；自我关怀与导师制是关键。

fadell.en: Start with a press release and painkiller products; opinion-based decisions for v1.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿和止痛药型产品出发；v1 决策基于观点而非数据。

fadell.en: Climate and energy efficiency are urgent; invest in green tech despite downturns.
fadell.zh: 气候与能效紧迫；尽管经济低迷，仍应投资绿色科技。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices will complement, not replace, smartphones; displays remain.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；设备将补充而非取代智能手机；显示屏仍必要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言锚定于物理现实。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient, vision provides richer world information.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足，视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能；JEPA 和世界模型对推理与规划至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI breakthrough requires non-generative world models for physical understanding.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；下一代 AI 突破需要非生成式世界模型以理解物理世界。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with hierarchical planning and open-source platforms will drive the decade of robotics.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具备分层规划的世界模型和开源平台将推动机器人十年。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；谷歌在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal; singularity is far away.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类级能力；存在风险微乎其微；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI systems lack consciousness; attributing it is dangerous; containment and alignment are key for superintelligence.
suleyman.zh: AI 系统没有意识；归因意识是危险的；遏制和对齐是超级智能的关键。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must build own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能通过对数线性 Scaling 临近；微软必须自建前沿模型；白领任务自动化，而非工作。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，互联网从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: AI-generated music is an instrument, not fake; uniqueness becomes harder with generative AI.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，AI 生成音乐是乐器而非伪造；生成式 AI 让独特性更难。

gustav.en: No single right org model; choose one fitting personality and optimize for what matters.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，没有唯一正确的组织模式；选择适合个性的并优化关键。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，生成式 AI 用自然语言赋予用户控制；优先福祉而非参与度。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe 100% until data says no, then change 100%.
gustav.zh: 始终，强烈观点但宽松持有：百分百相信直到数据否定，然后百分百改变。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmark scores; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agentic systems will maximize generalist returns.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体系统将最大化通才回报。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每个企业必须构建自己的爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage; security and containment critical for agent deployment.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识泄露；安全与遏制对智能体部署至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via enterprise hill-climbing, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，提出仅靠扩展非正式模型无法实现数学 AI，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月至 6 月，持续强调自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化无解命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，将形式化验证重新定义为扩展卓越能力，而非仅消除错误，并带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，明确非正式数学系统无法单独扩展至超级智能，形式化方法不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 始终认为，即使 AI 证明定理能力超人类，人类的品味与直觉仍至关重要。

murati.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early on; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她指出缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型在早期并不显而易见，将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信仰之跃。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要，安全研究必须公开进行。

murati.en: Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment; this remains a core principle.
murati.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，她始终认为通过公开反馈进行持续迭代部署能提升安全性与对齐，这一原则贯穿始终。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; time-based is key.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她提出交互模型应支持实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流对话；基于时间的设计是关键。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；我们拥有塑造 AI 未来的能动性。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth, not slowdown; reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; pre-training scaling still works but economic factors slow it.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期收益；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但经济因素使其放缓。

kaiser.en: Reasoning with RL and tools can solve hard problems but still needs vast data; generalization remains jagged.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理结合强化学习和工具能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；泛化仍呈锯齿状。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off; big labs may struggle with future pivots.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注并取得成功；大实验室未来可能难以应对类似转向。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential AI risk; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，近期风险（如系统入侵）比存在性 AI 风险更紧迫；开源因主权原因持续存在。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，指出算法效率三年可提升百倍，价值转向应用层，开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI augments jobs; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure; embrace risks.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张 AI 增强而非取代工作，主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施，政府应拥抱风险。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; pre-training saturates; differentiation via domain fine-tuning and enterprise customization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，认为模型商品化，预训练饱和，差异化来自领域微调与企业定制。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not destination; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，强调 AGI 是方向而非终点，企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in local, tool-accessible assistants; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调 AI 的价值在于本地化、能访问工具；随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; shared tools remain vital.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，技能以 markdown 文件形式实现超个性化自动化，但共享工具仍重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI excels at tedious background tasks; the real gap is people's understanding of what to delegate.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，AI 擅长处理繁琐后台任务；真正的差距在于人们理解可委托的内容。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel because they ask freely.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，明确任务用 Sonnet，模糊任务用 Opus；孩子因自由提问而表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: Asynchronous AI interaction is ideal; debug workflows with Claude, not just corrections.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，异步 AI 交互理想；用 Claude 调试工作流，而非仅纠正错误。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not just profit; simplicity requires joy and humanity, not just minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非仅追求利润；简洁需要愉悦和人性，而非仅仅是极简。

jonyive.en: Innovation should move things forward, not break for the sake of breaking; speed and quality can coexist with the right motivation.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动进步，而非为破坏而破坏；在正确的动机下，速度与质量可以兼得。

jonyive.en: Tradition is preserving the fire, not worshiping ashes; electric powertrains enable new design possibilities, turning constraints into opportunities.
jonyive.zh: 传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬；电动动力系统带来新的设计可能，将限制转化为机遇。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience matters; mimicking combustion engine sounds would be fake and disrespectful to users.
jonyive.zh: 用户体验的真实性至关重要；模仿内燃机声音是虚假的，对用户不尊重。

jonyive.en: Performance is multidimensional; longitudinal speed is boring, handling and lateral dynamics define a supercar.
jonyive.zh: 性能是多维的；纵向速度无聊，操控和横向动态定义超级跑车。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的规模扩张收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的扩展轴，可提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是潜力巨大的新领域，远超编码和数学范畴。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月，提出推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定，批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月，指出因推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，强调芯片内部数据搬运成本高于计算，脉动阵列可减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision scales quadratically with bit width, making FP4 3x FP8 throughput, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出低精度随位宽二次方扩展，FP4 吞吐为 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，认为 GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 拼接，并非根本不同。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will likely persist due to industry investment.
lambert.zh: RLHF 是最流行的微调技术，由于行业投资，它可能会持续存在。

lambert.en: Data quality matters more than algorithm choice; better data yields 10x improvement vs 1-2% from algorithms.
lambert.zh: 数据质量比算法选择更重要；更好的数据能带来 10 倍的提升，而算法只能带来 1-2% 的提升。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use.
lambert.zh: RLVR 是后训练中最大的突破，它实现了推理和工具使用。

lambert.en: Open models will be the engine for AI research for the next 10 years, enabling academic exploration.
lambert.zh: 开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，促进学术探索。

lambert.en: Chinese AI labs focus on meticulous engineering and execution, not paradigm invention.
lambert.zh: 中国 AI 实验室专注于细致的工程和执行，而非范式发明。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and start from solutions, not problems.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年：传统设计流程已过时，应信任直觉，从解决方案而非问题出发。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers spend less time mocking up, must help engineers execute, and vision is 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：设计流程已死；设计师花在模拟上的时间减少，必须帮助工程师执行，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers should adopt AI selectively, wait 6 months before new tools, and focus on judgment and ambiguity.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：设计师应选择性采用 AI，新工具等 6 个月再用，聚焦判断力和模糊性。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy to avoid model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉的端到端方法对自动驾驶是正确的。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0 is prompt-based; LLMs are like operating systems, and we are in the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0 是基于提示的；LLM 类似操作系统，我们处于智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs are jagged, and pre-training is like crappy evolution.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵，而非构建动物；LLM 能力参差不齐，预训练就像糟糕的进化。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agentic engineering means directing agents, and understanding remains the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我未再敲代码；智能体式工程意味着指挥智能体，而理解仍是人类的瓶颈。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，Scaling 推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment and governance are essential as systems become powerful.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，强调对齐紧迫性，迭代部署和治理对强大系统至关重要。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; measuring AI capabilities is becoming a bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，将自动化 AI 研究视为重要里程碑，同时指出能力测量成为瓶颈。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is core; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，认为通过 Scaling 预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心，思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training; autonomous agents require new supervision.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，长期对齐聚焦于训练分布外的泛化，自主智能体需要新监督范式。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration without goals improves it by preventing overfitting.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练分布的泛化是关键；无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索通过防止过拟合来提升泛化。

pathak.en: Scaling curiosity to real robots requires sample efficiency and cross-robot generalization; later, robotics becomes a data problem needing diverse data sources.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年到 2026 年，将好奇心扩展到真实机器人需要样本效率和跨机器人泛化；后来，机器人学成为数据问题，需要多样化的数据源。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is key.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，提出像 ChatGPT 之于语言一样的通用大脑可以驱动任何机器人；在多样化数据上预训练并在真实世界数据上后训练是关键。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics; unlike software, it cannot be scaled overnight and requires rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，部署是机器人学的主要挑战；与软件不同，它不能一夜之间扩展，需要严格的测试。

pathak.en: Consistently values generalization and data-driven approaches, from curiosity-driven exploration to pretraining on diverse data.
pathak.zh: 始终重视泛化和数据驱动的方法，从好奇心驱动的探索到在多样化数据上的预训练。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年，仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading; real progress requires deep human evaluations, not leaderboard optimization.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性；真正的进步需要深度人工评估，而非优化排行榜。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务来训练模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI 可能产生幻觉；人类判断至关重要，安全必须优先于准确性。

edwinchen.en: Quality data creation requires taste and sophistication; labs diverge in objective functions shaping diverse AIs.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据创建需要品味和精细度；不同实验室的目标函数分化，塑造出多样化的 AI。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，强调端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈，且现代工具使其可解释，颠覆了过去认为端到端不可解释的观点。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; hybrid rule-based and learned systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，提出世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，而混合规则与学习系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; scaling current approaches solves AV.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，认为纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达和激光雷达；扩展现有方法即可解决自动驾驶。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization; infrastructure and data quality trump algorithms.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调语言集成改善表征、推理和个性化；基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更重要。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is an AI problem solved by end-to-end learning; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; safety via minimal risk maneuvers.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，重申自动驾驶是 AI 问题，端到端学习是解法；消费车辆将超越 Robotaxi 规模；通过最小风险操作保障安全。

carlpei.en: Building a brand unites teams on purpose; survival is core; hardware is easier than software due to distribution challenges.
carlpei.zh: 打造品牌能凝聚团队共识，生存是核心；硬件比软件容易，因为软件的发行更难。

carlpei.en: Smartphones' future lies in generative UI and proactive agentic software, not hardware changes; AI will commoditize.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机的未来在于生成式界面和主动的智能体式软件，而非硬件变革；AI 将商品化。

carlpei.en: AI should be an ingredient, not a hype; focus on utility and user experience, not marketing AI features.
carlpei.zh: AI 应作为成分而非炒作点，聚焦实用性和用户体验，而非营销 AI 功能。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could; apps will disappear, opening APIs for agents.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜取代，只有脑机接口可能；应用将消失，为智能体开放 API。

carlpei.en: Design is key differentiator; marketing arbitrage via content creation; challenger brands must find efficient channels.
carlpei.zh: 设计是关键差异化；通过内容创作实现营销套利；挑战者品牌必须找到高效渠道。

turley.en: Model as product: iterate daily like software; ship fast to learn from real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品：像软件一样每日迭代，快速发布以从真实反馈中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; future interface will render its own UI, like Windows after MS-DOS.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；未来界面将自行渲染 UI，如同 MS-DOS 之后的 Windows。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investments, model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、富交互的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型无缝产品化。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow apps, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: AI 用于科学应瞄准根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型的幻觉在配合真值检测器时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 像代码这样可验证的领域，对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 如今，结合强化学习的后训练是推动超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs are like operating systems.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 接地气、减少幻觉至关重要；将 LLM 比作操作系统。

jimfan.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, providing infinite data and safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，认为模拟是训练具身智能体的关键，提供无限数据和安全探索。

jimfan.en: Data scarcity is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人领域数据稀缺是主要瓶颈，未来在于通过模拟和世界模型生成合成数据。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test (robot cleaning a messy house) is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，提出物理图灵测试（机器人整理凌乱房间）是具身 AI 的重大挑战。

jimfan.en: Intelligent robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，预测到 2040 年智能机器人数量将超过 iPhone；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在 5 年内到来。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升模型智能。

sholto.en: RL on verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon matters more than raw capability; coding leads progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体在时间跨度上的可靠性比原始能力更重要；编码是进步的领先指标。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands achievements, but compute becomes bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我将强化学习视为新的扩展轴，更长的智能体连贯性扩展了成就，但算力成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; future is managing agent teams.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要；未来是管理智能体团队。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with learning from video and generalist agents as promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，强调 AI 应作为增强人类能力的工具，并认为从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges; Africa can leapfrog legacy issues in AI adoption.
nando.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 安全和负责任部署是最大挑战，同时认为非洲在 AI 应用上可以跳过遗留问题，实现跨越式发展。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential for building beneficial AI, and human skills complement technical coding.
nando.zh: 始终强调多样性和包容性对于构建有益 AI 至关重要，并认为人际沟通等人类技能与编程技术相辅相成。

nando.en: From focusing on scaling and generalist agents to prioritizing safety and real-world deployment challenges.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年关注规模扩张和通用智能体，到 2026 年转向优先考虑安全性和实际部署中的挑战。

nando.en: Research should embrace failure and simplify problems; African researchers should believe they can apply to top institutions.
nando.zh: 2026 年，主张研究应拥抱失败并简化问题，同时鼓励非洲研究者相信自己有能力申请顶尖机构。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能媲美较大的模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我一直强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不够，后训练（尤其是 RLHF）对安全和对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我提出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是在插值人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be used during pre-training to improve reasoning, not just post-training.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张强化学习不仅用于后训练，也可在预训练阶段提升推理能力。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet; small models with diverse synthetic data can be powerful.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我认为多元对齐优于消除互联网偏见；通过多样化的合成数据，小模型也能变得强大。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非交互创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines should be dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南应是动态平台，而非静态规范。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用；早期投资品牌以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers autonomy; adapt process to problem, not universal template.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师自主权；流程应因问题而异，而非套用模板。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness trump perfection; gut decisions often beat data-driven ones in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，认为速度与决断优于完美；在快速成长的初创中，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; AI as a creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码为最终真相。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图，而非过程；副业项目可胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；忽视它如同早期忽视互联网。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，缩放定律预测进展；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，自然语言不会成为主要编程方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification; humans stay in driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，编程从代码转向更高层次的意图规范；人类保持主导。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，定制模型对产品质量至关重要；Cursor 中的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet; will take decades; senior engineers underrate AI, juniors over-rely.
truell.zh: 2025 年，AI 变革比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年；资深工程师低估 AI，初级工程师过度依赖。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. PhD in ML is best path; talent gap exceeds funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发。机器学习博士是成为安全研究者的最佳路径，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight. Alignment may be easier than thought; interpretability and automated research are key.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督。对齐可能比想象中容易，可解释性和自动化研究是关键。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient. Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化遭到侵蚀，仅靠后训练不足。第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管变得必要。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software advances; RL with simulation can achieve complex tasks like tennis.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要硬件和软件双重进步，通过强化学习和仿真可以实现网球等复杂任务。

abbeel.en: Shift from emphasizing RL and simulation to combining unsupervised learning with RL for sample efficiency.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 年强调强化学习和仿真，到 2021 年转向结合无监督学习与强化学习以提高样本效率。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns transferable to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他指出预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Hard-coding prior knowledge can introduce incorrect assumptions; use it for data generation instead.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他反对硬编码先验知识，主张将其用于数据生成或增强，以避免错误假设。

abbeel.en: Consistently values self-play, imitation learning, and transfer learning for robot skill acquisition.
abbeel.zh: 始终重视自博弈、模仿学习和迁移学习在机器人技能获取中的作用。

shazeer.en: Next-token prediction is AI-complete; scaling with compute and data improves intelligence; neural networks are alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 下一个词预测是 AI 完备问题；通过算力和数据扩展提升智能；神经网络内部如同炼金术，难以理解。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are key near-term opportunities; modular architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期关键机会；模块化架构（如专家混合）实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单独无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习对 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; coding is underhyped as AI application enabling self-acceleration; open-source models narrow gap.
shazeer.zh: AGI 被低估；编码作为 AI 应用被低估，能自我加速；开源模型缩小与前沿模型的差距。
